authorization: 认同你的观点。请你重新设定研究目标，并自主研究
objective: 研究新路径顺序观察的增量；有依据才支持原四门达标与抗扰动策略，组件统计不代表账户收益
selection_history: 已见EX060/061/064失败与EX066/067条件拆分结果后提出；非独立封存验证，不逆转方向或扫阈值挽救结果

feature_method.returns: r_i=log(C_i)-log(C_(i-1)), i=1..8; C_0=first Open; d_i=max(-r_i,0), u_i=max(r_i,0)

features.max_down_run_share: max over contiguous strictly negative-return runs of sum(d_i), divided by sum(d_1..d_8)

semantics.run: r_i<0 extends a run; zero or positive r_i interrupts it; select largest cumulative down move, not longest run length
semantics.no_down: If total_down=0 both shares=0; this denotes no negative close transition, not exhaustion or recovery
semantics.volume: Validated to match original eight-bar input contract; does not enter any feature
semantics.later_opens: Validated but unused; first Open anchors the first close transition
semantics.ratio_rounding: Shares bounded at 1 for floating sum roundoff only

hypothesis.early_down_share: positive relation to h4 next-open-entry net-return proxy after old information and daily down/up magnitude controls
hypothesis.max_down_run_share: negative relation to that h4 label
hypothesis.controls_required_for_future_statistics: old14 + both EX061 observations + total_down + total_up; no actual statistics in this package

input.index: unique strictly increasing finite timezone-naive DatetimeIndex; exact full eight-bar sessions

output.availability: after all eight T bars complete, earliest execution T+1
output.warmup: one complete session; no historical window
output.selection: retain every complete session including no-down cases

feature_method.parameters: none; fixed first four bars, fixed strictly negative runs; no threshold or direction search
limitations: Close transitions do not identify intrabar ordering, fund flows, or buyer/seller pressure.
Synthetic correctness is not evidence of profitability or independent predictive information.
Caller must establish authorized calendar, asset identity, HFQ units and time availability.
Future labels and realized profit must never determine signal population or feature definition.

label_contract.return_h: Open[T+1+h]/Open[T+1]*(1-.001)/(1+.001)-1; fractional open-fill fee proxy; h complete sessions held
label_contract.negative_gap_next: Not tested: next open gap is already realized before proposed entry
label_contract.maturity_columns: label_end_<label>; first test signal strictly after train label maturity

statistics.correlation: Spearman average ties; partial rank IC uses OLS residuals with intercept and all eighteen controls; residual norm <=1e-10 of original centered-rank norm is explained/unavailable
statistics.non_overlap: h+1 phases fixed by original full signal index positions before finite/opportunity filtering

bootstrap.sampling: overlapping full-time-axis blocks, uniform starts, truncate to original length; filter opportunity after sampling
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5% linear quantiles; at least 400 valid replicates
bootstrap.scope: all four predeclared scopes; descriptive, no search-selection correction

walk_forward.train: 2020 <= signal year < test year AND label_end_label < first actual test-year signaldate
walk_forward.groups: train feature Q25/Q75 linear; test low <= Q25, high >= Q75; original label means
walk_forward.ridge: rank features via train empirical CDF midpoint ties; original target; intercept unpenalized; alpha=10
walk_forward.common_model_rows: all 20 feature columns finite, target finite, training target mature; identical model rows
walk_forward.baseline: training target mean on identical training rows; compare test MSE and Spearman IC

statistics.scope: all, past20_declining, true original signal-flat eligible, declining-flat; no profitable-row selection
limitations: Already-seen development pool; chronological pseudo-out-of-sample, not sealed independent validation.
No hyperparameter search; all labels, years, phases, components and failures retained.
Future labels never enter feature columns, ECDF, thresholds, or fitting before maturity.
Intervals are descriptive diagnostics and do not correct development-pool selection bias.

scope_definition: past20_declining=original momentum20<0; flat_eligible=original confirmation_opportunity, verified eligible AND NOT previous original target_position; signal state is not actual account quantity
labels: EX066 fixed4/8 net-nextOpen proxy and paired downside exact reuse; .999/1.001 fee adjustment, no native limit/lot fills
stop: 缺乏一致控制后增量或跨年模型退化则停止两条固定表达；保留全部薄组及失败；不据事后结果反向或挑期限
boundaries: S013既有510500.SH至2026-09-30及原预热，既有公开数据请求只读，无外部provider/封存/跨族/DEV/PTE/生产/账户/参数搜索/32点
limitations: 首19日原控制缺失保留；零值/并列分位可能重叠，须披露；已见开发池；历史发布修订未验证；纯价格路径不能称资金流
